Q1: Which branch should the fix target?
Choices:
A. PR #6894's head branch `ai/issue-6882`, where the failure happened. Add an `Integration branch: ai/issue-6882` line so the fix lands on that branch. (RECOMMENDED)
B. The default branch `main`. Only valid if the failing test also fails on `main`.
C. Whichever branch reproduces the failure: try `ai/issue-6882` first, then `main`.
Q2: The failing test name cannot be read from the logs. What should the implementation do?
Choices:
A. Rebuild the shard-1 test list for group 3 of 4 the same way CI does (the `NR % total == n` split in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` lines 1390-1398), run those tests on the target branch, and make the smallest fix for whatever reproduces. If nothing reproduces, close the issue as a transient runner failure with no code change. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Do A. In addition, change the orchestrate-poll step in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` to copy each failed shard's `FAIL <test>: <error>` lines into its `::error::` annotation, so future triage can see the test name. Contract tests (`tests/test_ci_poll_test_sharding.py`) would be updated too. Do not change the aggregate `lint` gate or the shard-failure gate.
C. Make only the diagnostics change described in B, and fix no test.
